summary: Native Tiimo activities are ordered inside time-of-day buckets and carry no clock time; only imported calendar events do.
reason: Treating midnight-anchored bucket activities as real spans made every activity on a day collide with every other and made free-time arithmetic meaningless. Also means --at can only pick a bucket.
validated_outcome: overlaps went from 91 false pairs to 0 on a single day; 0 of 1190 mirrored activities carry a clock time.
